legend: Given an array A$$$A$$$ consisting of N$$$N$$$ positive integers where 1≤Ai≤M$$$1 \le A_i \le M$$$.
We define the shift operation as the following:
Let an integer X$$$X$$$ be good if X$$$X$$$ appears in A$$$A$$$ at least once, and the number of occurrences of X$$$X$$$ in the array is even (divisible by 2$$$2$$$).
Let S$$$S$$$ be the set of indices i$$$i$$$ where Ai$$$A_i$$$ is good.
For each index i$$$i$$$ in the set, you must change Ai$$$A_i$$$ into (AimodM)+1$$$(A_i \bmod M) + 1$$$, where mod$$$\bmod$$$ is the modulo operation (remainder when divided by M$$$M$$$).
You have to process Q$$$Q$$$ queries of two types:
2$$$2$$$ i$$$i$$$: print the value of Ai$$$A_i$$$.
Note that you have to answer T$$$T$$$ testcases.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer T$$$T$$$ (1≤T≤10$$$1 \le T \le 10$$$) — representing the number of testcases.

The first line of each testcase contains three integers N,M$$$N, M$$$ and Q$$$Q$$$ (1≤N,M,Q≤105$$$1 \le N, M, Q \le 10^5$$$) — representing the size of the array, the value of M$$$M$$$, and the number of queries.
The second line of each testcase contains n$$$n$$$ space separated integers A1,A2,…,AN$$$A_1, A_2, \dots, A_N$$$ (1≤Ai≤M$$$1 \le A_i \le M$$$) — representing the elements of the array.
Each line of the next Q$$$Q$$$ lines has one of the following forms:
2$$$2$$$ i$$$i$$$: representing an ask query (1≤i≤N$$$1 \le i \le N$$$).
It's guaranteed that the sum of N$$$N$$$, the sum of M$$$M$$$, and the sum of Q$$$Q$$$ over all testcases doesn't exceed 105$$$10^5$$$.
output: For each query of the second type, print one line containing a single integer — the value of Ai$$$A_i$$$.
